creator: Alexander Terp
description:
The "copy a directory" skill-include example installs to `scripts/helpers/`, not `scripts/`:

```yaml
- from: shared-scripts
  path: helpers/
  dest: scripts/
```

The trailing-slash rule ("preserves filename") applies to directories too, so the source directory is nested inside `dest`. The example's different `dest` name reads as a rename. Following its pattern with `path: guidelines/`, `dest: guidelines/` produced `guidelines/guidelines/*.md`; `dest: guidelines` gave the intended layout.

The example appears in four places:

- `assets/skills/tai/SKILL.md` (near line 846)
- `docs/src/content/docs/reference/skill-includes.md` (twice, near lines 36 and 95)
- `docs/src/content/docs/guides/creating-skills.md` (near line 323)

Change each to `dest: scripts`, and say beside the trailing-slash rule (SPEC.md near line 1830, the tai skill near line 872, the docs reference) that a trailing slash on a directory `dest` nests the source directory inside it. The nesting comes from `computeDestPath` in `internal/install/include.go`, which appends the source's base name whenever `dest` ends in `/`.

(Moved from GitHub issue #12, part 4.)
title: Fix the 'copy a directory' include example, which nests the directory
